resources.string: Spaces reached by either Langerhans cell branch
Add the left and right counts. Any total above 10 is overlap. Distinct spaces reached = total minus overlap, so each space is counted only once. The chart rounds the controls to whole spaces.

Langerhans cells in the epidermis have branching extensions (dendrites) that reach between keratinocytes and help sample the local surroundings. To illustrate overlap, picture 10 numbered spaces in a row between neighboring cells. Two branches of the same cell are drawn covering consecutive spaces from opposite ends of the row. One space is one drawing position, not a unit of skin area. The layout and counts are invented and do not measure sampling or predict an immune response.
